title: SB 320 (2021-2022 (134th General Assembly)): S. B. No. 320: Requires photo identification to vote
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) R.C. 3505.18(A)(1)
(quote) When an elector appears in a polling place to vote, the elector shall announce to the precinct election officials the elector's full name and current address and provide photo identification.
(section) R.C. 3501.01(AA)
(quote) "Photo identification" means one of the following documents or combinations of documents that includes the individual's name, photograph, and current address: (1) An unexpired Ohio driver's license, commercial driver's license, or state identification card issued by the registrar of motor vehicles or deputy registrar under Chapter 4507. of the Revised Code. If the driver's license or state identification card does not contain the elector's current address, the driver's license or state identification card shall be accompanied by a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document ... that shows the individual's name and current address.
(section) R.C. 3501.01(AA)(2)
(quote) An expired Ohio driver's license, Ohio commercial driver's license, or state identification card issued by the registrar of motor vehicles or deputy registrar under Chapter 4507. of the Revised Code and an unexpired United States military identification card. If the driver's license or state identification card does not contain the elector's current address, the driver's license or state identification card shall be accompanied by a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document ... that shows the individual's name and current address.
(section) R.C. 3505.18(A)(1)
(quote) STRUCK: proof of the elector's identity in the form of a current and valid ... , a military identification, or a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document, other than a notice of voter registration mailed by a board of elections under section 3503.19 of the Revised Code, that shows the name and current address of the elector
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) R.C. 3505.18(A)(2)
(quote) If an elector does not have or is unable to provide photo identification to the precinct election officials, the elector may cast a provisional ballot under section 3505.181 of the Revised Code and do either of the following: (a) Write the elector's Ohio driver's license or state identification card number or the last four digits of the elector's social security number on the provisional ballot envelope; or (b) Appear at the office of the board of elections not later than the seventh day after the day of the election and provide photo identification, the elector's Ohio driver's license or state identification card number, or the last four digits of the elector's social security number.
(section) R.C. 4507.50(C)
(quote) A person seventeen years of age or older may apply to the registrar or a deputy registrar for the issuance to that person of an identification card or a temporary identification card under this section without payment of any fee prescribed in division (B) of this section.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) R.C. 3509.03(B)(5)
(quote) Both of the following: (a) The elector's Ohio driver's license or state identification card number or a copy of the front and back of the elector's photo identification; (b) The last four digits of the elector's social security number
(section) R.C. 3509.05
(quote) The elector shall provide the elector's Ohio driver's license or state identification card number on the statement of voter on the identification envelope or a copy of the front and back of the elector's photo identification enclosed in the return envelope, and also shall provide the last four digits of the elector's social security number on the statement of voter on the identification envelope
(section) R.C. 3509.03(B)(5)(c)
(quote) STRUCK: (c) A copy of the elector's current and valid photo identification, a copy of a military identification, or a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document, other than a notice of voter registration mailed by a board of elections under section 3503.19 of the Revised Code, that shows the name and address of the elector
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) R.C. 3503.16 (movers and name changers)
(quote) STRUCK: identification in the form of a current and valid ... a military identification, or a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck, or other government document ... that shows the name and current address of the elector
(section) R.C. 3503.19 and 3503.28 (registration notice text)
(quote) STRUCK: Voters who do not have any of the above forms of identification, including a social security number, will still be able to vote by signing an affirmation swearing to the voter's identity under penalty of election falsification and by casting a provisional ballot.
(other) 3503.14: registration form adds 'or state identification card' to licence number
(other) 3503.16: movers and name-changers no longer show non-photo ID
(other) 3503.19, 3503.28: registration notice and voter information text changed to photo identification
(other) 3505.181-3505.183: provisional ballot rules and notices changed to photo identification
(other) 3509.03-3509.10, 3511.02-3511.13: absentee and military/overseas application and envelope ID rules aligned to photo ID or licence/ID number plus last four SSN
(other) 3509.051 (in-person absentee): photo ID; provisional ballots allowed at in-person absentee voting; ballots may be scanned before polls close
(other) 3509.08: board employees' home deliveries count as mail, not in-person, for ID rules
(other) 4507.50, 4507.52: free state ID card to anyone 17 or older; 4507.502 (new): BMV reimbursement for free cards
(other) note: Photo-ID bill. The saved text is word-for-word identical to H.B. 650 (134th GA) after the enacting clause (checked by word diff), so the two are companion bills. Sole version. Ellipses in quotes mark omitted repeated words only.
